title: Next Cheaper Offer
statement: A list of offers is ordered by time. For each offer, return the first later offer that is strictly cheaper, or −1 if none is.

answerKey.pattern: Monotonic stack: next smaller to the right
keyPoints: Keep indexes whose prices increase from bottom to top
When a cheaper offer arrives, it answers each pricier offer on top; pop them
Push the current index; leftovers get −1
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Scan right from each offer: O(n²)

hints: It is the mirror of "next greater". Which way should the stack be ordered?
Increasing from bottom to top: offers wait until something cheaper arrives.
Pop while the current offer is cheaper than the top, answering each popped offer.
